div.head: V As 1.2
div.ab: ⁊ swylc gerefa swylc ðis forgemeleasie ⁊ ymbe beon nylle, gesylle ðam cinge his oferhyrnesse, gif hit man him ongerecce mid soþe.
And swylce gerefa swylce ðis forgymeleasige ⁊ ymb beo nylle, gesylle ðæm cyng his oferhyrnysse, gif him mon ongerecce mid soþe, ⁊ he hine ungereccan ne mæge.
Et prepositus qui hoc peruertet et inde curare nolet, emendet regi suam ouerhernessam, si pernoscatur hoc in ueritate, et se non possit reicere.
⁊ swylc gerefa swylc ðis foregemeleasie ⁊ ymbe beon nylle, gesylle ðam cinge his oferhyrnesse, gif hit man him ongerecce mid soþe, [⁊ he hine ungereccan ne mæge].

Und jeder Vogt, welcher dies vernachlässigt und dafür nicht sorgen will, zahle dem Könige [Busse für] Ungehorsam gegen ihn, wenn man ihn dessen wahrheitsgemäss anschuldigt (und er sich nicht entschuldigen kann lq).
And any reeve who neglects this and will not attend to it, let him pay the king [the fine for] disobedience to him, if he is truthfully charged with it (and he cannot clear himself, lq).
And any reeve who neglects this, and pays no heed to it, shall pay [the fine] for insubordination to the king, if he is justly accused and cannot clear himself.
And such reeve as neglects this and will not be zealous about it is to pay to the king the fine for disobedience to him, if he is truly accused of it.

note.seg: Der königliche Beamte als Gerichtsleiter scheint wegen Nachlässigkeit bedroht, zwar diesem Zusammenhange gemäss nur bei Aufsicht übers Gefolgswesen, dagegen laut der Quelle und der Wiederholung IV As 7 bei aller Gesetzausführung; s. Gl Amtsvergehen 2; Vogt 24

The royal official presiding over the court appears to be threatened for negligence — according to this context, it is true, only in supervising matters of the retinue, but according to the source and to the repetition in IV As 7, in all execution of the law; see Gl Amtsvergehen 2; Vogt 24

on trennt von gerecce Toller. — Der Zusatz in lq ist pleonastisch und fehlt IV As 7, ist wohl also nicht durch H nur fortgelassen, sondern nicht archetyp. Das Wort ungereccan ist unbedenklich; vgl. unbindan, undon, ungyrdan, unhadian, untynan usw. — Q wählt reicere, das Lat. [Angriff] ‘abweisen, zurückstossen’ bed., im Sinne von ‘entschuldigen’ nur wegen Buchstabengleichheit, wie sonst recitare; s. d. Wb

Toller separates on from gerecce. — The addition in lq is pleonastic and is lacking in IV As 7; it was therefore probably not simply omitted by H, but is not archetypal. The word ungereccan is unobjectionable; cf. unbindan, undon, ungyrdan, unhadian, untynan etc. — Q chooses reicere, which in Latin means ‘to repel, beat back’ [an attack], in the sense of ‘to excuse’ only because of the identity of letters, as elsewhere recitare; see that word in Wb
i.e. 120 shillings; see II Edw. cap. 20 (cf. cap. 1, above).
